# Aspen Search

> Boutique executive search firm specializing in connecting top engineering and research talent with leading quantitative trading firms and venture-backed technology companies.

Aspen Search focuses on highly specialized technical and quantitative roles, emphasizing fit between exceptional candidates and selective employers.

## Pages

- [Index](https://aspensearch.com/): Home page outlining Aspen Search’s executive search focus, target industries, and approach to matching technical talent with employers.
